name: Candelilla
desc: Candelilla (Asclepias albicans): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Asclepias albicans is a species of milkweed known by the common names whitestem milkweed and wax milkweed. It is native to the Mojave and Sonoran Deserts of California, Arizona, and Baja California.
